tasks.title: Make parseFrontmatter CRLF-tolerant and normalize line endings
tasks.description: Fix the cross-platform defect where doctor falsely reports 'missing schema_version frontmatter' on Windows. parseFrontmatter in cli/appbuilder.js only accepts a leading '---\n' delimiter, so git autocrlf (which rewrites files to CRLF on checkout) makes the parser bail. Make the delimiter check accept CRLF as well as LF, add a .gitattributes that normalizes tracked text artifacts (.md/.json) to LF so the rewrite stops happening, and add a regression test. Written test-first.
acceptance_criteria: parseFrontmatter returns schema_version for frontmatter that begins with a CRLF-terminated '---' delimiter.
.gitattributes normalizes tracked .md and .json artifacts to LF.
doctor passes on a Windows checkout of projects/*/architecture.md.
A new test covers CRLF frontmatter parsing and the full suite passes.
